description: Source code for the class GeneratedFileTargetGenerator, which handles generating file targets in a build system, including setting output types, contents, data keys, rebase paths, and output conversions.

classes.name: GeneratedFileTargetGenerator
classes.description: A class responsible for generating and configuring file targets within the build system, including setting contents, output paths, and other properties.

methods.name: DoRun
methods.description: Executes the main logic for configuring the generated file target, including setting output type, contents, data keys, rebase, walk keys, and output conversion.

methods.name: FillContents
methods.description: Sets the contents of the target if specified.

methods.name: IsMetadataCollectionTarget
methods.description: Checks if a variable is used when contents are already defined, to prevent conflicts.

methods.name: FillOutputConversion
methods.description: Sets the output conversion property of the target if specified.

methods.name: FillRebase
methods.description: Sets the rebase directory for the target if specified.

methods.name: FillDataKeys
methods.description: Populates the data keys for the target if specified.

methods.name: FillWalkKeys
methods.description: Populates the walk keys for the target, with default if not specified.
